keen_edge.title: On the Keening of Edges
keen_edge.text: A blade kept hungry cuts before the arm commits. Sharpen at dusk, never at dawn.

heavy_mail.title: The Weight That Saves
heavy_mail.text: Mail is not worn to stop a blow. It is worn to make the blow arrive late.

long_stride.title: Marches of the Ninth
long_stride.text: Ground taken before the fight is ground you are not asked to bleed for.

the_vigil.title: A Vigil Kept in Winter
the_vigil.text: Those who learn to stand awake learn also to stand wounded.

swift_water.title: Reading of Swift Water
swift_water.text: The current does not hurry. It simply never stops to consider.

the_climb.title: Concerning the Climb
the_climb.text: Height is only an obstacle to those who arrive at it in a hurry.

the_open_palm.title: Fist of the Open Palm
the_open_palm.text: The first doctrine any world discovers. It says almost nothing, and is never wrong.
